title: ṭāb: engine, agents and replication package
description:
Rules engine, heuristic and learned agents, tournament harness and complete raw results for the IEEE Transactions on Games paper Tactical Lookahead and Heuristic Calibration in the Ancient Board Game of ṭāb: A Systematic Study of Agent Design (Hassanat and Altarawneh).

Includes: the rules engine with the formalized freeing, invasion, freeze, one-strike re-entry and LIFO stacking rules; all agents (GA baselines, the TLA lookahead family, the PSA phase-sampling baseline, MCTS at four budgets and two tree depths, and a TD(λ) value network); the tournament harness with the exact commands and seed bases behind every table and figure; raw per-game records for roughly 400,000 games; the 342-decision human alignment dataset with the 11 underlying expert game logs; and a browser-playable build of the engine with the trained network embedded.
